bayts.text: O Allah, O One, bless for ever and grant peace upon the Prophet Aḥmad,
master of every non-Arab and Arab, and upon the Family and the Companions, people of (divine) nearness.
O Allah, O Benefactor, bless for ever him whose pre-eminence has been made everlasting,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions, with every Muslim.
O Allah, O Benefactor, bless with peace Your Prophet, who drives away the darkness,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him this composition the best of compositions, and drive harm toward others than us.
O Allah, O One, bless on my behalf the Prophet, the Chosen One, by grace,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and make my speech sound and teach my heart.
O Allah, O Gentle, bless for ever him who through You was guided and worshipped,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to his Family and his Companions; and speak to me (inwardly).
O Allah, O Gentle, bless eternally him who leads to You whoever worships,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, with peace, O my return.
O Everlasting, Who through Yourself freed me from (saying) "give me", and guarded my quarters from harm,
bless with a growing peace the Prophet, master of every kinsman and stranger,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bless, O Giver, and grant peace at all times upon Your Prophet, imām of the righteous,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me a guidance for which many will (holily) envy me, while I abide in my homeland.
And make my passage, outward and inward, good for me, (making me) a grateful servant abiding (here).
And bless, O Loving (Al-Wadūd), and grant peace upon the Hashimite Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bless, O King (Al-Malik), and grant peace upon him whom You taught, and he knew,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me an affection that endures with success, without hardship, and make righteousness easy for me.
And bless, O Gentle, with the most excellent blessing, and grant peace upon him whose loftiness has appeared,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make me master of my soul, and drive the Accursed toward others than me, before he heads for me, O Helper.
And make my desire a follower of what You love, and grant me among creatures what I love from You,
without harm and without enmity, and spare me what draws wretchedness.
Āmīn, O Lord, by the sanctity of the Prophet; and keep every harm away from my heart.
And bless, O One, for ever our master Muḥammad, the gate of the heights,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and guard all of me from harm and pain.
O Giver, Who gave me the Book, bless the Effacer, who erased reproach,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and make my pen great.
Guard my reed-pen, my heart, the ink and my body from what is not reward and right conduct.
And teach me today what I did not know, and accept with thanks, for Your noble Face, my words.
And make my pens and my ink aimed at Your good pleasure, reaping the best sowing.
And purify the outward and the inward, O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), and protect me.
And erase what afflicts me in my soul with "Be!", just as before You loosened my constraint.
And free both my outward and my inward from faults, and gather my wishes for me.
And bless, O Generous, and grant peace upon him whom I have taken as a ladder for myself,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me longing for Your good pleasure and detachment from what is not pleasing to You.
And bless, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), and grant peace upon him to whom I turned my pen,
through You, for Your noble Face, Aḥmad, and the Family and the Companions; and make my life praiseworthy.
And decree for me security and righteousness, without their being taken away, O Lord, and success.
And bless, O Guide (Al-Hādī), with a blessing that never departs, and grant the best peace that never departs,
upon the surpassing Prophet and Messenger, Muḥammad, the best of creation, the pure,
upon his Family and his Companions; and make me possessed of protection, and occupy me with Your good pleasure.
And grant me the sweetness of habitual practices, and with You make me the desire of the masters.
O You Who bless and grant peace upon Your Prophet, for whom the heights appeared,
bless him and grant him peace, Lord, on my behalf, for ever, with the Family and those devoted to worship
among his Companions; and make easy for me with "Be!" every hardship, guide me and establish me.
